site.anchor: a falsificação é apta a enganar (Súmula 73 STJ)

source.quote: Art. 289 - Falsificar, fabricando-a ou alterando-a, moeda metálica ou papel-moeda de curso legal no país ou no estrangeiro:

readings.description: Any falsification of currency is moeda falsa, however gross.
readings.rejection_rationale: STJ Súmula 73: using grossly counterfeit paper money is, in principle, estelionato (art. 171), not art. 289.

readings.description: Art. 289 needs a falsification able to deceive; a gross counterfeit is, in principle, estelionato (art. 171).

taken.rationale: Settled by a súmula of the STJ's Terceira Seção. Encoded as the judge's finding `falsificação grosseira, incapaz de enganar, reconhecida pelo juiz`, which takes the case out of the caput and §§ 1º and 2º (the forms that turn on a counterfeit); §§ 3º and 4º concern genuine money and do not read it. The súmula speaks of 'utilização'; reading it into the caput's making as well follows the sweep's framing (capacity to deceive as an element).

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 73: "A utilização de papel moeda grosseiramente falsificado configura, em tese, o crime de estelionato, da competência da Justiça Estadual."

witnesses: cp-g5-moeda-falsa-testes.l4: `fabrica uma falsificação grosseira`, `introduz uma falsificação grosseira` — no crime
notes: Reserved id: M-sweep-c-19 opened this fork (sweep-c.forks-proposed.json). sweep-b's M-sweep-b-36 (in sweep-b's register) records the same súmula from art. 171's side.

site.anchor: o falso é absorvido pelo crime-fim (Súmula 17 STJ)

source.quote_absent_reason: The question is not in the Code's words: consunção is a rule of the concurso aparente de normas that the courts apply to arts. 297 to 304; Súmula 17's text is quoted in settled_by.

readings.description: The falsity is punished as well, in concurso with the crime it served.

citations.cite: STJ Súmula 17 and Tema 933 reject it

readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 17: a falsity spent in the estelionato, with no further harmful potential, is absorbed by it; Tema 933 the same for descaminho.

readings.description: A falsity spent in the crime it served, with no further harmful potential, is absorbed by it (consunção), even where that crime carries the lower penalty.

taken.rationale: Settled. Encoded as the judge's finding `o falso se exauriu no crime-fim, sem mais potencialidade lesiva, reconhecido pelo juiz`: the forms of arts. 297 to 304 still say the words were met, and the exported crime rules for those articles leave the case out. Arts. 296 and 305 are outside the entry's reach and do not read it.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 17: "Quando o falso se exaure no estelionato, sem mais potencialidade lesiva, é por este absorvido."

witnesses: cp-g5-falsidade-documental-testes.l4: `falsifica escritura, exaurida no estelionato`; `usa escritura falsificada, exaurida no estelionato`
notes: Reserved id: M-sweep-c-20 opened this fork. The date is the súmula's judgment date as sweep-b recorded it from scon (Terceira Seção, julgado em 20/11/1990, DJ 28/11/1990).

source.quote: Art. 307 - Atribuir-se ou atribuir a terceiro falsa identidade para obter vantagem, em proveito próprio ou alheio, ou para causar dano a outrem:

readings.description: The constitutional privilege of self-defence covers giving a false identity to the police to avoid self-incrimination; not typical.
readings.rejection_rationale: STF Tema 478 and STJ Súmula 522 hold the conduct typical despite the self-defence alleged.

readings.description: Typical despite alleged self-defence; a formal crime, consummated on giving the false data with the aim, whatever follows.

taken.rationale: Settled. The rule does not read self-defence at all: a case records `perante a autoridade policial, para ocultar maus antecedentes, em alegada autodefesa` and the answer is unchanged (phrasebook entry 10.3's invariance). Tema 1255 is honoured by making the aim, not a result, the element.

settled_by.citation: Tema 478, RE 640.139/DF: "O princípio constitucional da autodefesa (art. 5º, LXIII, da CF/88) não alcança aquele que atribui falsa identidade perante autoridade policial com o intento de ocultar maus antecedentes, sendo, portanto, típica a conduta praticada pelo agente (art. 307 do CP)."

witnesses: cp-g5-outras-falsidades-testes.l4: `se diz outro à polícia para esconder antecedentes` — crime
notes: Reserved id: M-sweep-c-06 opened this fork. STJ Súmula 522 (Terceira Seção, 25.3.2015) holds the same (M-sweep-c-07).

site.anchor: a regra de aplicação da pena do Capítulo II (art. 359-M-A)

citations.cite: STF, decisions of 9.5.2026 in the execution proceedings concerning 8.1.2023 (as quoted by Agência Brasil)

source.quote: Art. 359-M-A. Quando os delitos deste Capítulo estão inseridos no mesmo contexto, a pena deverá ser aplicada, ainda que existente desígnio autônomo, na forma do concurso formal próprio de que trata a primeira parte do art. 70, vedando-se a aplicação do cômputo cumulativo previsto na segunda parte desse dispositivo e no art. 69, todos deste Código. (Incluído pela Lei nº 15.402, de 2026)

readings.description: One of arts. 359-L and 359-M absorbs the other.
readings.rejection_rationale: AP 2668: autonomous types protecting distinct legal goods; no consunção either way.

readings.description: Autonomous types with desígnios autônomos: penalties summed under art. 69, no 359-M-B reduction. The STF's holding in AP 2668; what the STF's 8-January executions apply while the 9.5.2026 suspension lasts.

Art. 359-M-A: for Capítulo II crimes in one context, the graver penalty increased by a sixth to a half (art. 70, first part), never above the art. 69 sum (art. 70, parágrafo único), even with desígnios autônomos; plus art. 359-M-B's reduction in a crowd for one who neither financed nor led; reaching earlier facts as lex mitior (art. 2º, parágrafo único).
Arts. 359-M-A and 359-M-B struck in the ADIs, leaving concursoMaterial everywhere.

citations.cite: STF, ADIs 7966-7969 (pending; with the relator since 8.7.2026) and ADI 7985 (seguimento negado 17.7.2026; agravo regimental 22.7.2026), per the STF's case pages

readings.foreclosure: No judgment: four ADIs are pending (7966-7969), ADI 7985's denial of seguimento is under agravo regimental, and the 9.5.2026 suspension is not an erga omnes cautelar (M-sweep-c-09).

taken.rationale: The text in force is applied wherever no court order stays it: from 8.5.2026 (dated by the day the penalty is APPLIED, since both articles favour the agent and reach earlier facts under art. 2º, parágrafo único), art. 359-M-A's concurso formal próprio and art. 359-M-B's reduction. In the one class of proceedings the 9.5.2026 decision reaches — the STF's execution proceedings about 8 January 2023 — the encoding takes neither side: it REFUSES, naming the suspension and the ADIs, rather than silently answering with the statute or with AP 2668's art. 69. The flag that selects that arm is an input on the proceeding (`execução penal no STF relativa a 8 de janeiro de 2023, alcançada pela suspensão de 9.5.2026`).

witnesses: cp-g5-estado-democratico-testes.l4: `abolição e golpe` → concurso formal próprio, 56 months to 18 years; the same case in a suspended execution → REFUSED; `na multidão, na execução suspensa` → REFUSED; `na multidão, aplicada antes da lei` → no reduction
notes: Reserved id: M-sweep-c-09 opened this fork; M-sweep-c-26 bears on it; sweep-a's M-sweep-a-08 (in sweep-a's register) records the same law as a restriction on arts. 69 and 70. Currency risk: the ADIs could strike both articles.

Art. 70 is g1b's; its fraction ('de um sexto até metade') and parágrafo único are restated in cp-g5-estado-democratico.l4 for art. 359-M-A and should be tied to g1b's rule by a cross-check at integration.

With 359-L's and 359-M's preceitos, art. 70 parágrafo único's cap can never bind in the abstract (359-M's 12 years × 3/2 = 18 < the 20-year sum); it can on the quantities a judge fixes, and that is tested.

source.quote: § 1º - Equipara-se a funcionário público quem exerce cargo, emprego ou função em entidade paraestatal, e quem trabalha para empresa prestadora de serviço contratada ou conveniada para a execução de atividade típica da Administração Pública. (Incluído pela Lei nº 9.983, de 2000)

readings.description: The § 1º equiparação ('Equipara-se a funcionário público ...') counts wherever the Code says 'funcionário público', Título X included.

citations.cite: CP art. 327, caput ('para os efeitos penais') e § 1º

readings.description: The equiparação reaches only the crimes of Título XI (crimes by officials against the administration).
readings.rejection_rationale: § 1º's words carry no such limit, and the caput it attaches to says 'para os efeitos penais'.

taken.rationale: Art. 327 is g6a's. Since integration (2026-09-30, conductor's ruling recorded as F-g6a-23) g5 CALLS g6a's owner rule instead of its own reading: the caput answers for any date, and both § 1º limbs REFUSE by name for a fact before Lei nº 9.983/2000's vigência (16.10.2000; 15.10.2000 refuses as the uncertain day). g5's earlier reading answered FALSE for those facts; the change is recorded, with the flipped assertions, in notes/integration.md, 'Art. 327 ruling'.

witnesses: cp-g5-moeda-falsa-testes.l4: `o empregado da paraestatal emite em excesso em outubro` — art. 289 § 3º
notes: For the conductor: tie g6a's art. 327 rule and this reading by a cross-check assertion at integration (phrasebook entry 1.9).
Integration 2026-09-30: tied to g6a's rule by calling it, which makes the proposed cross-check unnecessary.

source.quote: § 4º - Nas mesmas penas incorre quem desvia e faz circular moeda, cuja circulação não estava ainda autorizada.

readings.description: 'Nas mesmas penas': § 3º's, reclusão de três a quinze anos, e multa — the preceito immediately before, also about genuine money in the course of its issue.
'Nas mesmas penas': the caput's, reclusão de três a doze anos, e multa, as in § 1º.
readings.foreclosure: Not refuted; not taken because § 3º is the nearest preceito and shares § 4º's object (genuine money not yet issued).

taken.rationale: Nearest preceding preceito, and the same object; the readings differ only in the maximum (15 against 12 years).

witnesses: cp-g5-moeda-falsa-testes.l4: `pena do art. 289, § 4º` EQUALS reclusão 3 a 15 anos, e multa

site.anchor: crime assimilado qualificado do art. 290, parágrafo único

source.quote: Parágrafo único - O máximo da reclusão é elevado a doze anos e multa, se o crime é cometido por funcionário que trabalha na repartição onde o dinheiro se achava recolhido, ou nela tem fácil ingresso, em razão do cargo.

readings.description: 'funcionário' is art. 327's funcionário público; 'em razão do cargo' gives the reason for the easy access.
'funcionário' means anyone employed in the office, public official or not.
readings.rejection_rationale: 'em razão do cargo' presupposes a post in the public office; and the Code's 'funcionário' elsewhere is art. 327's.

taken.rationale: The office where withdrawn money is held is a public one, and 'cargo' is a public post.

witnesses: cp-g5-moeda-falsa-testes.l4: `um particular que trabalha na repartição forma cédula` — caput's penalty

source.quote: § 2º - Quem, tendo recebido de boa-fé, como verdadeira, moeda falsa ou alterada, a restitui à circulação, depois de conhecer a falsidade, é punido com detenção, de seis meses a dois anos, e multa.

readings.description: The one who received the money in good faith as genuine is § 2º's agent. Passing it on after learning it false is § 2º's alone; keeping it, the holding every § 2º case begins with, is carved out of § 1º for him as well, so that keeping alone is no crime. § 1º's other verbs (selling it on as counterfeit, for instance) stay whole.
Both § 1º ('introduz na circulação') and § 2º are met, and the heaviest (§ 1º's) governs.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would leave § 2º's lighter penalty with no case of its own.

readings.description: The good-faith receiver who keeps the money after learning it false commits § 1º's 'guarda'.
readings.rejection_rationale: It punishes keeping the money (three to twelve years) more heavily than passing it on (§ 2º: six months to two years), and since every § 2º receiver keeps the money before passing it on, § 1º's 'guarda' would be present in every § 2º case and § 2º would again have no case of its own.

taken.rationale: Specialty: the privileged paragraph describes exactly this agent, and the holding that precedes its conduct goes with it.

witnesses: cp-g5-moeda-falsa-testes.l4: `restitui de boa-fé depois de conhecer` and `guarda e restitui moeda recebida de boa-fé, depois de saber` → § 2º only; `guarda moeda recebida de boa-fé, depois de saber` → no crime; `vende a um receptador moeda recebida de boa-fé, depois de saber` and `recebe sabendo e restitui` → § 1º
notes: The carve-out of 'guarda' was added with the dolo element of fork F-g5-34 (2026-10): once § 1º needs knowledge, a receiver who learned the truth and kept the money met § 1º's 'guarda', which ta-g5 had found convicting even a receiver who did not know.

delegated_field: emitido sem permissão legal; a lei veda ao estrangeiro a propriedade ou a posse de tais bens

site.anchor: um dos documentos referidos no art. 292

source.quote: Emitir, sem permissão legal, nota, bilhete, ficha, vale ou título

readings.description: Whether another law permits the issue (art. 292) or forbids the foreigner the asset (art. 310) is that law's answer, which the fact-supplier points to: an input.
Encode the other laws' permissions and prohibitions.
readings.rejection_rationale: They are outside the Code and the source bundle.

taken.rationale: Both are normas penais em branco completed by other laws; entry 1.6's reading 1.

site.anchor: recebimento ou uso do art. 292, parágrafo único

source.quote: Quem recebe ou utiliza como dinheiro qualquer dos documentos referidos neste artigo

readings.description: 'como dinheiro' qualifies both 'recebe' and 'utiliza': receiving the paper as money.
Any receipt of such a paper is enough.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would punish a collector or a court receiving the paper as evidence.

taken.rationale: The enum carries the reading: `receber como dinheiro`, `utilizar como dinheiro`.

provisions: every g5 offence that is not a 'tentar' offence

source.quote_absent_reason: The question is what the Code does not say: no provision of Título X or XII excludes an attempt.

readings.description: Art. 14 applies to every offence; whether a single-act conduct (using a document, giving a false identity) could be split so as to be begun and not completed is the fact-supplier's, through the stage of execution.
Single-act ('unissubsistente') offences admit no attempt, and the encoding should say so article by article.
readings.rejection_rationale: That is doctrine, not the text; art. 14 has no exception for it, and an article-by-article list would be the encoder's.

taken.rationale: The Code decides attempts in one place; the stage is a fact a witness can give.

source.quote: Art. 295 - Se o agente é funcionário público, e comete o crime prevalecendo-se do cargo, aumenta-se a pena de sexta parte.

readings.description: 'o crime' is any crime of Capítulo II: arts. 293 and 294.
Only art. 293.
readings.rejection_rationale: The article stands after both and names neither.

taken.rationale: Its place, closing the Capítulo after arts. 293 and 294.

witnesses: cp-g5-papeis-publicos-testes.l4: `o funcionário possui a máquina, prevalecendo-se do cargo` — art. 294 increased

source.quote: § 4º - Quem usa ou restitui à circulação, embora recebido de boa-fé, qualquer dos papéis falsificados ou alterados, a que se referem este artigo e o seu § 2º, depois de conhecer a falsidade ou alteração, incorre na pena de detenção, de seis meses a dois anos, ou multa.

readings.description: The one who received the paper in good faith is § 4º's agent. Using it or restoring it to circulation is § 4º's alone, and keeping, possessing or holding it, the holding every § 4º case begins with, is carved out of § 1º, I and II and § 3º for him as well, so that holding alone is no crime.
§ 1º or § 3º also met, and the heaviest governs.
readings.rejection_rationale: § 4º's lighter penalty would have no case of its own.

readings.description: The good-faith receiver who keeps the paper after learning the truth commits § 1º, I's 'guarda, possui ou detém'.
readings.rejection_rationale: Keeping (two to eight years) would be punished more heavily than using (§ 4º: six months to two years, or a fine), and every § 4º receiver holds the paper before using it, so § 4º would have no case of its own.

taken.rationale: As at art. 289 § 2º (F-g5-04): the privileged paragraph describes exactly this agent, and the holding that precedes its conduct goes with it.

witnesses: cp-g5-papeis-publicos-testes.l4: `usa de boa-fé, depois de saber, vale postal falso` and `guarda e usa de boa-fé, depois de saber, vale postal falso` → § 4º only; `guarda de boa-fé, depois de saber, vale postal falso` → no crime

site.anchor: comércio de produto do art. 293, § 1º, III

source.quote: III – importa, exporta, adquire, vende, expõe à venda, mantém em depósito, guarda, troca, cede, empresta, fornece, porta ou, de qualquer forma, utiliza em proveito próprio ou alheio, no exercício de atividade comercial ou industrial, produto ou mercadoria:

readings.description: 'no exercício de atividade comercial ou industrial' governs every verb of the inciso.
It governs only the last verb, 'utiliza em proveito próprio ou alheio'.
readings.rejection_rationale: § 5º's equiparação speaks of the whole inciso III, and keeping a stamped product at home for one's own use is not what the inciso reaches.

taken.rationale: § 5º equates irregular trade 'para os fins do inciso III do § 1º' — the whole inciso.

witnesses: cp-g5-papeis-publicos-testes.l4: `guarda cigarro com selo falso, em casa, para consumo` — no crime

source.quote: Pena - a cominada à falsificação ou à alteração.

Only the base preceito, with no lucro fine.

readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 304 punishes the use; the aim that matters is the user's.

taken.rationale: The group's uniform rule for several forms.

source.quote: § 2o Se da ação ou omissão resulta dano à administração pública: (Incluído pela Lei 12.550. de 2011)

readings.description: 'da ação ou omissão' is the caput's action or § 1º's action or omission.
Only the caput.
readings.rejection_rationale: 'ou omissão' fits only § 1º ('permite ou facilita'), so § 1º must be included.

taken.rationale: The word 'omissão'.

witnesses: cp-g5-fraudes-em-certames-testes.l4: `deixa estranhos entrarem, com dano à administração` → § 2º

source.quote: § 3o Aumenta-se a pena de 1/3 (um terço) se o fato é cometido por funcionário público. (Incluído pela Lei 12.550. de 2011)

readings.description: The status is enough; no act in the function is required.
The official must act in or by reason of the function.
readings.rejection_rationale: Other paragraphs say so when they mean it (art. 311 § 1º, 'no exercício da função pública ou em razão dela'); this one does not.

taken.rationale: Contrast with neighbouring provisions.

witnesses: cp-g5-fraudes-em-certames-testes.l4: `o funcionário divulga gabarito` → increased

source.quote: § 2º Se o agente participa de operação bélica com o fim de submeter o território nacional, ou parte dele, ao domínio ou à soberania de outro país:

readings.description: § 2º is a conduct of its own (taking part in a military operation), not needing the caput's negotiation; § 1º's increase is the caput's only ('das condutas previstas no caput').
§ 2º qualifies the caput and needs the negotiation too.
readings.rejection_rationale: It states its own conduct and aim.

taken.rationale: The paragraph's own verb and aim.

witnesses: cp-g5-estado-democratico-testes.l4: `participa de operação bélica` → § 2º; `participa de operação bélica, e a guerra é declarada` → no § 1º increase

source.quote: Art. 359-L. Tentar, com emprego de violência ou grave ameaça, abolir o Estado Democrático de Direito, impedindo ou restringindo o exercício dos poderes constitucionais:

readings.description: 'impedindo ou restringindo o exercício dos poderes constitucionais' is inside the attempt: the agent seeks to prevent or restrict; success is not needed.
The conduct must actually prevent or restrict the powers' exercise, at least in part.
readings.foreclosure: Not refuted; not taken because everything after 'Tentar' reads as the object of the attempt in a crime de atentado.

taken.rationale: A crime de atentado punishes the attempt; the gerund describes what is attempted.

source.quote: Art. 359-R. Destruir ou inutilizar meios de comunicação ao público, estabelecimentos, instalações ou serviços destinados à defesa nacional, com o fim de abolir o Estado Democrático de Direito:

readings.description: 'destinados à defesa nacional' qualifies establishments, installations and services; means of communication to the public count as such.
It qualifies all four, means of communication included.
readings.foreclosure: The masculine plural agrees either way; not taken because means of communication 'ao público' are not destined to national defence, and the Capítulo is 'serviços essenciais'.

taken.rationale: Grammar leaves it open; sense and the Capítulo's heading favour this reading.

witnesses: cp-g5-estado-democratico-testes.l4: `destrói a torre de uma emissora para abolir o Estado` → crime

citations.cite: CP art. 14, parágrafo único ('Salvo disposição em contrário')

source.quote: Art. 359-M. Tentar depor, por meio de violência ou grave ameaça, o governo legitimamente constituído:

readings.description: In a 'tentar' offence the crime is complete once the execution has begun; art. 14's reduction does not apply, and art. 15's desistance cannot undo an attempt already made.
Art. 15 applies: one who gives up answers only for the acts done.
readings.foreclosure: Not taken: the acts done are the attempt the article punishes.

taken.rationale: PLAN § 2.3 and the text's 'Tentar'.

witnesses: cp-g5-estado-democratico-testes.l4: `invade as sedes e desiste` → crime; `invade as sedes e é contido` → no attempt reduction

delegated_field: manifestação crítica aos poderes constitucionais; atividade jornalística; reivindicação de direitos e garantias constitucionais ...

source.quote: Art. 359-T. Não constitui crime previsto neste Título a manifestação crítica aos poderes constitucionais nem a atividade jornalística ou a reivindicação de direitos e garantias constitucionais por meio de passeatas, de reuniões, de greves, de aglomerações ou de qualquer outra forma de manifestação política com propósitos sociais.

readings.description: Whether a conduct is protected criticism, journalism or a claim to rights is the judge's finding; where found, no crime of the Título.

Art. 359-T protects manifestation, not violent conduct: where the record shows violence or a grave threat, the 359-T finding does not clear a crime whose elements include them (arts. 359-J, 359-L, 359-M, 359-P) and the crime subsists. Live: CF art. 5º, XVI protects assembly only 'pacificamente, sem armas'; the text of art. 359-T says nothing about violence.
Derive it from facts (no violence, public place, a stated social aim).
readings.rejection_rationale: Any such criterion beyond the violence recorded would be the encoder's, not the text's (phrasebook area 8).

taken.rationale: An evaluative standard is an input: the 359-T finding is supplied, and it clears non-violent conduct of every crime of the Título. Where the record ALSO shows violence or a grave threat, the Code's text does not decide between the readings achadoDoJuiz and exclusaoNaoAlcancaViolencia (CF art. 5º, XVI protects assembly only 'pacificamente, sem armas'), so the encoding refuses by name (conductor's ruling, 2026-10-08): `crime violento do Título XII` gives REFUSE, naming F-g5-29 and both readings, for arts. 359-J, 359-L, 359-M and 359-P, the crimes whose elements include violence or a grave threat (359-I, 359-K, 359-N and 359-R have none and are cleared by the finding as before). Both readings stay live; violent conduct without the finding is a crime.

source.quote: § 4º Não constitui crime a comunicação, a entrega ou a publicação de informações ou de documentos com o fim de expor a prática de crime ou a violação de direitos humanos.

readings.description: § 4º reaches every form of the article (caput and §§ 1º to 3º).
Only the caput's delivery, since § 4º speaks of 'comunicação, entrega ou publicação'.
readings.rejection_rationale: 'Não constitui crime' is general within the article.

taken.rationale: The paragraph's unqualified 'Não constitui crime'.

witnesses: cp-g5-estado-democratico-testes.l4: `empresta a senha para expor violação de direitos humanos` → no crime

source.quote: § 1º - Falsificar, no todo ou em parte, atestado ou certidão, ou alterar o teor de certidão ou de atestado verdadeiro, para prova de fato ou circunstância que habilite alguém a obter cargo público, isenção de ônus ou de serviço de caráter público, ou qualquer outra vantagem: Pena - detenção, de três meses a dois anos.

readings.description: Art. 301 (caput and § 1º) and art. 302 describe particular certificates, each with a lighter penalty; for the same paper they exclude arts. 297 and 298 (the forged certificate) and art. 299 (the false statement in one). Through art. 304's 'a cominada à falsificação ou à alteração', the user of such a paper takes the privileged penalty too.
Arts. 297 to 299 are also met, and the heaviest penalty governs (F-g0-18), for the forger and, in art. 304, for the user.
readings.rejection_rationale: Every forged certificate is a public or a private document, and every false certificate is a false statement in a document, so arts. 301 and 302 would have no case of their own.

taken.rationale: As at arts. 289 § 2º and 293 § 4º (F-g5-04, F-g5-09): the privileged provision describes exactly this conduct. The carve-outs sit in the forms of arts. 297, 298 and 299, so art. 304, which takes its penalty from those forms, reaches § 1º's for the user as well. How wide 'qualquer outra vantagem' reaches is the circumstance the case supplies (`fato ou circunstância que habilite alguém a obter cargo público, ...`); this fork does not narrow it.

witnesses: cp-g5-falsidade-documental-testes.l4: `falsifica certidão pública para obter cargo` → not art. 297, art. 301 § 1º's penalty; `falsifica certidão para obter cargo` → not art. 298; `usa certidão pública falsificada para obter cargo` → art. 304 with § 1º's penalty; `atesta e insere declaração falsa, em razão da função, para dar vantagem` and `o médico dá atestado falso, inserindo declaração falsa para alterar a verdade` → not art. 299
notes: Raised by ta-g5 (2026-10) for art. 301 § 1º against arts. 297, 298 and 304; the same carve-out was applied to art. 301 caput and art. 302 against art. 299, which stood in the same relation.

site.anchor: o uso é absorvido pela falsificação (post factum impunível)

source.quote: Art. 304 - Fazer uso de qualquer dos papéis falsificados ou alterados, a que se referem os arts. 297 a 302: Pena - a cominada à falsificação ou à alteração.

readings.description: One who forged or altered the paper, as author or participant, and then uses it is punished for the forgery (arts. 297 to 302) alone; the use is its post factum impunível. For it: art. 304's penalty is the forgery's own ('a cominada à falsificação ou à alteração'), so for the forger the use adds no harm to the fé pública the forgery did not already carry, and counting it again punishes one course of conduct twice.

The forgery and the use both stand, in concurso material (art. 69). For it: art. 304 does not exclude the forger from its agents ('Fazer uso de qualquer dos papéis falsificados ou alterados'), and ta-g5's reasoning on IT-g5-115 is that no provision of the Code states absorption either way. `uso do art. 304` keeps saying that the forger's use meets the article's words.

NOT a reading of the law: what the encoding does while the fork is open. Where every other element of art. 304 is made out (the use begun or completed, the falsity not found spent in the crime it served) and the user is also the author or a participant of the forgery, the two readings give different answers, so the model declines; where they agree it answers.

citations.cite: CP art. 304, 'Fazer uso de qualquer dos papéis falsificados ou alterados', which does not say whether the forger is an agent of the use

taken.rationale: The fork is open and neither reading of the law is taken. The Code does not say whether the forger who uses his own forgery answers for the use as well. The only authority offered for `postFactum` is the test case's own `alternative` (ta-g5, IT-g5-115: STJ case law is said to treat the forger's use as a post factum impunível, and 'an encoding that takes that line should record it as a fork citing the ruling'). That statement is not in the sweep register, whose nearest entry, M-sweep-c-20, is Súmula 17 and Tema 933 on a falsity spent in estelionato or descaminho, nor in the source; no ruling has been retrieved for this register, and what the STJ or STF hold on the forger's own use is not asserted here. Without a citation the encoding does not take that line. `taken` names the encoding's own behaviour, as at F-g2b-01 and F-g5-29, because the register requires a `taken` that names a live reading and naming a reading of the law the code does not apply would misstate the code. `crime de uso de documento falso (art. 304)` refuses by name in that case, and `uso do art. 304` and `o uso é absorvido pela falsificação (post factum impunível)` keep stating each reading's predicate. Whether the user took part in the forgery is the court's finding (`o agente do uso é autor ou partícipe da falsificação do papel`), carried on the use, like Súmula 17's exhaustion (F-sweep-c-12). Until 2026-10-11 `postFactum` was taken.

witnesses: cp-g5-falsidade-documental-testes.l4: `falsifica escritura e a usa` and `falsifica escritura e tenta usá-la` → `uso do art. 304` holds (reading ambos) and so does `o uso é absorvido pela falsificação (post factum impunível)` (reading postFactum), and the crime of art. 304 is REFUSED, while `falsifica escritura pública` stands under art. 297; `falsifica escritura e não inicia o uso`, `falsifica escritura e a guarda sem usar` and `falsifica escritura, a usa e o falso se exaure no estelionato` → no crime of art. 304 on either reading, with no refusal; `usa escritura falsificada` (a user who did not forge) → art. 304
cp-ind-g5-falsidade-documental.l4: IT-g5-115 (Túlio forged the licence and used it; expected REFUSE) is REFUSED
notes: Raised by ta-g5 (2026-10): before this, arts. 297 and 304 both stood for the forger, with no fork. This encoder has not verified a court citation for either reading; one should be added before canon.

Second look 2026-10-11 (IT-g5-115). The independent pass's 2026-10-09 re-run still reported 'TRUE and TRUE, no fork', which was already out of date: this entry and its post factum rule landed earlier, and with the fixture then in the file (`, com:` EMPTY, no authorship and no knowledge) art. 304 came out false for a reason the case does not state. The case expects REFUSE, and its own `alternative` makes taking the post factum line conditional on citing a ruling that this register does not have, so the encoding now declines where the readings part. The fixture of IT-g5-115 now records that Túlio is the author of the forgery; no expected value changed.
See also fork(s): F-g5-31, F-g5-34, F-g5-29, F-g2b-01, F-sweep-c-12.

source.quote: Parágrafo único. Para fins do disposto no caput, equipara-se a documento particular o cartão de crédito ou débito.

readings.description: The equiparação is for art. 298's caput only. For arts. 299, 300 and 305, which say 'documento público ou particular' in their own words, a card stands where it stood for every article before Lei 12.737/2012: whether it is a document the text does not say (F-g5-14), and the encoding refuses. Art. 304 still reaches a forged card, because it points to 'os papéis ... a que se referem os arts. 297 a 302' and art. 298 refers to the card.
The card is a private document wherever the Code says 'documento particular', as F-g5-11 reads art. 297 § 2º.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 297 § 2º opens 'Para os efeitos penais'; art. 298's parágrafo único opens 'Para fins do disposto no caput'. The contrast is the text's own limit.

readings.description: Outside art. 298 a card is not a document, so arts. 299, 300 and 305 never reach it.
readings.foreclosure: That a card is not a document is one side of the division F-g5-14 records; the text answers neither side outside art. 298's caput.

taken.rationale: The paragraph's own opening words confine it; where it does not reach, the encoding returns the answer it gives where the text is silent (F-g5-14). The document is tested last in arts. 299 and 305, so only a card that meets every other element is refused.

witnesses: cp-g5-falsidade-documental-testes.l4: `destrói cartão alheio, em prejuízo alheio` → REFUSED (crime and penalty, art. 305); `insere declaração falsa em cartão para criar obrigação` → REFUSED (art. 299, and the penalties of arts. 299 and 300); `destrói o próprio cartão` → no crime, decided before the card; `usa cartão clonado` → art. 304 with art. 298's penalty
notes: Raised by ta-g5 (2026-10): before this, art. 305 took a card for a private document. Related forks in this register: F-g5-14 (a card before Lei 12.737/2012) and F-g5-11 (art. 297 § 2º's 'Para os efeitos penais').

delegated_field: the agent's knowledge of what the thing is: `o agente sabia que a moeda era falsa ou alterada` (art. 289 § 1º), `... que a cédula fora formada de fragmentos ou recolhida` (art. 290), `... que o objeto era destinado à falsificação de moeda` (art. 291), `... que o papel ou o selo era falsificado ou alterado` (art. 293 §§ 1º and 3º), `... que o objeto era destinado à falsificação dos papéis do art. 293` (art. 294), `... que o selo, sinal ou papel era falsificado, alterado ou reproduzido` (arts. 296 § 1º I, 303 p.ú., 304), `... que a marca ou sinal era falsificado` (art. 306), `... que o veículo estava remarcado ou adulterado` and `... que o objeto era destinado à adulteração de sinal identificador` (art. 311 § 2º I and II), `... que o conteúdo era sigiloso` (art. 311-A), `... que o documento ou informação era classificado` (art. 359-K)

site.anchor: o agente conhecia a falsidade da moeda

source.quote: Parágrafo único - Salvo os casos expressos em lei, ninguém pode ser punido por fato previsto como crime, senão quando o pratica dolosamente.

readings.description: Knowledge of what the thing handled is (false, altered, meant for counterfeiting, confidential, classified) is part of the dolo each crime needs (art. 18 p.ú.), and an error about it excludes dolo (art. 20). It is the court's finding, supplied on the case; absent, there is no crime. One who made, altered or reproduced the thing himself knows it, and needs no separate finding.
Knowledge is presumed from possession or use; ignorance is a defence the case must assert.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 18 p.ú. punishes a fact only when committed dolosamente: dolo is an element of the crime, not an exception to it. Defaulting it to present convicted the good-faith receiver who kept notes taken as genuine (ta-g5, 2026-10).

readings.description: Carry cp-dominio's `Elemento subjetivo` (dolo, culpa) on each case, as g2a and g4b do.
readings.rejection_rationale: No article in this range has a culpable form, so `culpa` could only ever mean 'no crime'; and the case at issue, an agent who took the thing for genuine, is an error about an element, which the two members cannot state, since such an agent may have acted with neither dolo nor culpa as to the falsity. The finding these articles turn on is the knowledge itself, named after its object.

taken.rationale: A finding of fact, positive, named after what the article says the thing is. Each verb of possession, dealing, use or delivery in the range reads it; the agent's own making, altering, reproducing or removing of a mark implies it.

witnesses: cp-g5-moeda-falsa-testes.l4: `guarda moeda falsa sem saber`, `guarda moeda recebida de boa-fé, sem saber`, `vende moeda falsa sem saber`, `restitui sem saber cédula formada de fragmentos`, art. 291 with the agent not knowing → no crime

cp-g5-papeis-publicos-testes.l4: `guarda passe falso sem saber`, `usa vale postal falso sem saber`, `vende selo falso sem saber`, `expõe à venda, na loja, cigarro com selo falso, sem saber`, `usa vale postal sem carimbo, sem saber`, `possui máquina de fazer vale postal, sem saber` → no crime

cp-g5-falsidade-documental-testes.l4: `usa selo público falsificado, sem saber`, `vende selo raro reproduzido, sem saber`, `usa escritura falsificada, sem saber` → no crime; `fabrica selo público e o usa` → art. 296 caput and § 1º, I
cp-g5-outras-falsidades-testes.l4: art. 306 'usar' not knowing; `o funcionário licencia o carro adulterado, sem saber`, `possui aparelho de remarcar chassi, sem saber` → no crime
cp-g5-fraudes-em-certames-testes.l4: `usa gabarito vazado, sem saber do sigilo`, `deixa estranhos entrarem, sem saber do sigilo` → no crime
cp-g5-estado-democratico-testes.l4: `entrega segredo sem saber que é classificado` → no crime
notes: Raised by ta-g5 (2026-10) for art. 289 § 1º and asked for arts. 291, 293 § 1º I, 294 and 311 § 2º II; every verb of possession, dealing, use or delivery in the range was then checked.

Checked and left without a separate finding: the agent's own making, altering, forging, inserting or omitting (arts. 289 caput and §§ 3º–4º, 290's forming and removing, 293 caput and § 2º, 296 caput, 297–302, 303 caput, 306's falsifying, 311 caput); art. 292 p.ú. (what the receiver may not know is that no law permitted the issue, an error about the law, art. 21); art. 293 § 1º, III, b (the missing stamp is plain on the product; not knowing tax law requires one is art. 21's); art. 296 § 1º, II and III (a genuine seal or symbol: 'indevidamente' qualifies the agent's own use); art. 305 (destroying or hiding a document the agent holds); arts. 307 to 310 (the agent's own pretence or interposition); art. 311 § 2º, III (its own 'devesse saber', F-g5-21); art. 311-A § 1º's 'pessoas não autorizadas' (only the confidentiality is required to be known); art. 359-K § 1º ('conhecendo essa circunstância', already in the text) and § 3º (facilitation, left as written); the rest of Título XII (violence, grave threat or a stated aim in every type).
Other groups' possession and use crimes may carry the same gap; that is the conductor's to check.
